name: openmcad-native
description: Native dependencies for the OpenMCAD geometry and constraint-solver shims.

dependencies.name: opencascade
dependencies.comment: ADR-0001. The geometry kernel. Pinned via builtin-baseline below; do not float it. Determinism (PLAN.md 5.2.3) depends on a fixed OCCT version AND fixed build flags.

dependencies.name: eigen3
dependencies.comment: ADR-0006. Required by planegcs. MPL2; the optional LGPL-licensed components are excluded by the default feature set. See PLAN.md 8.6.

comment: P0-T06 sets up the manifest only. Two things must be settled before the Phase 1 spike:
1. Replace builtin-baseline with a real vcpkg commit SHA. It is a placeholder so the
manifest is syntactically complete without silently pinning to a version nobody chose.
2. Record the resolved OCCT version and its build flags in docs/notes/occt-spike.md.
PLAN.md 14 asks for a three-day timeboxed spike before Phase 1 for exactly this reason.
